text: Mor Lam leapt onto his sleeping platform, pulled a coarse indigo blanket over his chin, and began groaning with theatrical agony.
Moussa rushed to his friend’s side, eyes wide with distress.
Moussa wept, pulling up a low stool.
'I shall not leave your side for a single second until health returns to your limbs!'
When hours passed and Moussa showed no signs of departure, Mor Lam closed his eyes, held his breath, and feigned a profound and sudden demise.
